entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 19316224572460416: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 138.3400 +/- 0.3177 mas (same row, RUWE 7.28): 7.23 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 1778.585, 1477.306 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 4,662 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 16160 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: HR 753 is not in the catalogue; kiehling: HR 753 is not among its 60 stars; kharitonov: HR 753 is not in the catalogue; burnashev: BS 753 is not in part2), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffe0c3. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 16160 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: HR 753 is not in the catalogue; kiehling: HR 753 is not among its 60 stars; kharitonov: HR 753 is not in the catalogue; burnashev: BS 753 is not in part2; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,662 K and log g 4.52 (u1 0.747, u2 0.044): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
